tools.name: convert_color
tools.description: Converts a color into code for 12 formats: HEX, HEX8, rgba(), hsla(), closest CSS named color, closest Tailwind class, SwiftUI Color, UIColor, Jetpack Compose, Android XML, Flutter, and React Native. Applies each platform's alpha byte order (RRGGBBAA on the web, AARRGGBB on Android/Compose/Flutter).

color.description: Color in any supported notation: hex (#F43, #FF6347, #FF6347CC), rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), a CSS named color (tomato), or a Tailwind token (red-500).

alpha.description: Opacity 0–1. Overrides any alpha embedded in the color input. Defaults to the input's alpha, or 1.

tools.name: check_contrast
tools.description: Computes the exact WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio between a foreground and background color (relative-luminance formula) and reports AA/AAA pass-fail for normal text (4.5 / 7), large text (3 / 4.5), and UI components (3).

foreground.description: Foreground (text) color. Color in any supported notation: hex (#F43, #FF6347, #FF6347CC), rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), a CSS named color (tomato), or a Tailwind token (red-500).

background.description: Background color. Color in any supported notation: hex (#F43, #FF6347, #FF6347CC), rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), a CSS named color (tomato), or a Tailwind token (red-500).

tools.name: swiftui_color
tools.description: Generates every SwiftUI Color initializer for a color: Color(red:green:blue:), opacity variant, Color(.sRGB), Color(.displayP3), HSB, hex-extension call, #colorLiteral, UIColor/NSColor bridges — plus a reusable `extension Color` snippet and Asset Catalog Contents.json.

color.description: Color in any supported notation: hex (#F43, #FF6347, #FF6347CC), rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), a CSS named color (tomato), or a Tailwind token (red-500).

alpha.description: Opacity 0–1. Defaults to the input's alpha, or 1.

name.description: Optional swatch name for the `extension Color` snippet (e.g. "Brand Primary" → `Color.brandPrimary`).

tools.name: generate_uuid
tools.description: Generates cryptographically random UUIDs: v4 (random), v7 (RFC 9562 time-ordered; batches stay strictly ordered), or NIL. Supports uppercase, hyphen-less, and braced formatting. 1–100 per call.

count.description: How many UUIDs to generate (1–100). Default 1.

tools.name: hash_text
tools.description: Computes MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 digests of a UTF-8 string, or HMAC variants when a key is given (HMAC-MD5 unsupported). Stateless; input is not stored.

hmac_key.description: Optional HMAC key. When set, outputs are HMAC digests.

tools.name: convert_timestamp
tools.description: Converts between Unix epoch timestamps and human-readable dates. Accepts epoch seconds / milliseconds / microseconds (auto-detected by magnitude), ISO 8601 / RFC 2822 strings, or "now". Returns seconds, millis, micros, ISO 8601 UTC, RFC 7231 UTC, the wall-clock time in a requested IANA timezone, and a relative description.

input.description: Epoch timestamp (e.g. "1735689600", "1735689600000"), ISO 8601 / RFC 2822 date string, or "now".

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the wall-clock output (e.g. "Asia/Seoul"). Default UTC.
